name: Qingxiao

tierList.prydwen: T0 Tower of Adversity, T1 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Aero Sword Tune Strain DPS fighting mostly in mid-air, reminiscent of Luuk Herssen. Extremely simple rotation (hold Basic Attack almost the whole time) building toward the enhanced Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning inside her Ephemeral Transcendence state, amplified by 'Mindlock' stacks from Tune Strain application.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Stringblade (4 hits, alternating Sheathed/Drawn Stance).
skills.resonanceSkill: Severing Note: Judgement - Aero hit, builds Qin Heart.
skills.forte: Formless Heart Sword - governs Qin Heart/Sword Cadence -> Heavy Attack: Stringblade -> Ephemeral Transcendence -> Heart Sword Intent -> Heavy Attack: Heaven's Reckoning chain, and Mindlock stacking (up to 65% DMG Amplification).
skills.liberation: Billows Beneath Heaven - Aero AoE hit, castable mid-air.
skills.intro: Tonality Shift - Aero hit, +30 Sword Cadence.

echoSet: Heart of Evil's Purge (100%, best - 40% Aero DMG + 20% CRIT DMG conditional on Tune Strain, trivially met)

teams.name: Best Team
teams.notes: Denia+Mornye specifically is her intended best-in-slot team; Denia without Mornye causes major DPS drop-offs with no good alternative.

teams.name: Lynae Team
teams.notes: More flexible alternative with smaller drop-offs if Mornye is unavailable.

rotation: Intro -> Heavy: Stringblade Mid-air 1,2,3 -> Stringblade Basic 3,4 -> Skill: Judgement -> Heavy: Stringblade -> Heavy: Transcendence 1-4 -> Heavy: Heaven's Reckoning -> Ultimate -> Outro. Nearly executes itself by holding Basic Attack.
communityNotes: Prydwen: top-tier single-target damage with arguably the simplest DPS rotation in the game's history, but among the most teambuilding-restrictive modern releases (needs Denia+Mornye specifically or Lynae + premium support) and struggles in multi-wave/AoE content like Luuk.
